$comment: Accepted-risk npm-audit advisories. The CI gate in
scripts/check-audit.js compares current audit output against this
file: advisories whose (GHSA id, package) pair is NOT listed here
cause CI to fail. Each entry blesses one advisory against ONE
package — the same GHSA appearing on a different package requires
its own entry. If `nodes` is present on an entry, the gate also
requires the current audit's `nodes` for that advisory to be a
subset of the listed nodes; a new dependency path (e.g., the
advisory escalates from a dev-only chain to a runtime chain)
fails the gate until re-triaged.
Adding entries: only when the advisory has been triaged and the
risk is understood (e.g., a moderate ReDoS in a dev-only
markdown linter that runs on trusted internal markdown). Include
`nodes` so a future dependency-path change can't slide through.
Removing entries: when the advisory is actually fixed in our deps
(then the gate flips to clean, the entry becomes dead, and we
delete it).
Baseline established 2026-05-11 alongside the gate's introduction.
Refresh process documented in CONTRIBUTING.md > Supply-Chain
Pinning > npm audit baseline.

accepted.title: brace-expansion: Zero-step sequence causes process hang and memory exhaustion
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only. brace-expansion@1.x reaches us via the minimatch@3.x → glob@7.x chain used by jest tooling and markdownlint-cli2. The vulnerable path is only exercised against trusted glob patterns hard-coded in package.json scripts (`markdownlint-cli2 "**/*.md"` and jest's test discovery), never against untrusted brace strings. Production server doesn't depend on brace-expansion. Accepted until the jest + markdownlint chains publish updates that pull in a fixed brace-expansion. If a runtime dep later pulls in brace-expansion, `nodes` will grow and the gate will fail until the new occurrence is re-triaged.

accepted.title: js-yaml has prototype pollution in merge (<<)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2. js-yaml only loads .markdownlint.json/.yaml in dev, never user-supplied YAML at runtime. Production server doesn't import js-yaml. Accepted until markdownlint-cli2 upgrades. `nodes` pins the dev-only path; any new node (e.g., a runtime dep adopting js-yaml) fails the gate.

accepted.title: markdown-it has a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
accepted.rationale: Transitive dev-only via markdownlint-cli2 → markdownlint → markdown-it. Only parses repo-local trusted markdown during lint. Production server doesn't render markdown. `nodes` pins the dev-only path; any new occurrence (e.g., a runtime dep using markdown-it) fails the gate.
